notes.title: The Chuusotsu Are Back!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148930/Chuusotsu_15th_Graduation_The_Moving_Castle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36565403/3517a64515121454de97343e568e8828b86460bc.png[/img][/url]
Arue and her quirky Chuusotsu crew are back!

Can Arue survive her first trip to a certain doujin event in the Big Site? Find out today!

We're happy to announce the worldwide premiere of Chuusotsu! 1.5th Graduation: the Moving Castle, a sequel to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630870/Chuusotsu_1st_Graduation_Time_After_Time/]Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation: Time After Time[/url] by Studio Beast.

The game supports English and Japanese languages, and directly continues the story of the first game.

Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation and all DLC are also a record -40% off this week, and owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7049/Graduation_Bundle/]Graduation Bundle[/url] can get an extra -10% discount.

Welcome aboard the Chuusotsu train!

notes.title: Get Ready for Wacky Philosophizing - Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation Is Here!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/630870/Chuusotsu_1st_Graduation_Time_After_Time/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28680774/bff0ebb120465c124b0b0c6b099bdcc4bebd5b09.jpg[/img][/url]
The colorful story of three good-for-nothing Chuusotsu girls, Arue, Koiro and Arara, is here! 

The trio ends up sharing an apartment in a far future world where everyone's lives are dictated by "seals" assigned to them by the government. The three girls have all been deprived of their seals for various reasons, and hilarity ensues as they must complete a philosophy assignment for a chance to get their lives back on track.

Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation comes with English and Japanese languages, with Japanese voice acting and an estimated playtime of 15-20 hours.

After a successful Kickstarter campaign, the Steam version comes with an all-new opening movie and 4 new CGs not in the original Japanese release!

[i]Let's do philosophy![/i]

notes.title: Chuusotsu - 1st Graduation Now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28680774/d706b7f7fea326c71f1dac2ee92f3dd7fff9ffe7.jpg[/img]
Our first Kickstarter project is now live! Studio Beast's new visual novel Chuusotsu - 1st Graduation is now gathering funding on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/215814918/chuusotsu-1st-graduation-a-visual-novel-with-philo]Kickstarter[/url]!

Chuusotsu is a fun, colorful story of three girls brought by their individual circumstances to live under the same roof and being forced to tackle existential questions to win their place in society. We are bringing Chuusotsu to fans all over the world in [b]dual language[/b] (English and Japanese text, characters fully voiced in Japanese). 

You can help us make the project a success, fund improvements to the game, as well as grab a limited edition [b]physical Collecter's Edition[/b] by heading over to the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/215814918/chuusotsu-1st-graduation-a-visual-novel-with-philo]Kickstarter page[/url] and spreading the word!

Chuusotsu is expected to release in late 2017.

[i]Let's do Philosophy![/i]
